data.reportText: Banco Bradesco Sa American Depositary Shares is expected* to report earnings on  10/22/2026 after market close.  The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Sep 2026.  According to Zacks Investment Research, based on  3 analysts'  forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $0.13.  The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $0.09.
